02Who we are

Independent by design, aligned by principle

Rubens Capital Partners is an independent real estate asset and investment management firm. We invest and operate in the Netherlands and USA on behalf of institutional investors and family offices. We are specialised in structuring, managing and optimising real estate investments. Owning the full value chain from acquisition and underwriting through to active asset management and exit. An independent partner with a long-term perspective with disciplined strategy and clear alignment of interests.

Rubens Capital Partners was founded on the conviction that successful real estate investment management requires discipline, independence and a clear governance framework.

06Doing good

A broader societal responsibility

Rubens Capital Partners is mindful of its broader societal responsibility. In addition to its core activities, Rubens Capital Partners selectively supports initiatives that contribute to positive social impact. This support may take the form of financial contributions, in-kind support or targeted assistance to individuals and organisations pursuing socially beneficial objectives, such as education, healthcare, environmental protection and public welfare.

Rubens Capital Partners believes that doing good is an integral part of doing business responsibly and seeks to make a meaningful and sustainable contribution to society, in line with its values and long-term vision.

07Governance

Governance

Rubens Capital Partners places strong emphasis on high corporate standards, with compliance and risk management forming a fundamental part of its business operations. The firm is committed to building long-term relationships with its clients, based on trust, transparency and professionalism.

Rubens Capital Partners operates within a robust governance framework consisting of policies, procedures, best practices and internal guidelines, all grounded in sound ethical principles. For parts of its fund activities, Rubens Capital Partners holds an AIFMD licence and thereby assures its stakeholders that strong corporate governance is embedded throughout its business processes.

08Careers

Careers

Rubens Capital Partners is continuously looking for motivated and committed professionals to strengthen its team. We are a growing, independent asset and investment manager with a strong focus on quality, responsibility and long-term value creation.

Working at Rubens Capital Partners means being part of a compact and professional organisation with short lines of communication, where substance, entrepreneurship and collaboration are key. Our team consists of driven specialists with diverse backgrounds in investment management, asset management, finance, risk & compliance and operations.

We offer an environment that encourages initiative, personal development and professional depth. Professionals who recognise themselves in our values and ambition are warmly invited to get in touch with us — also when no specific vacancy is available at that time.

Interested in a future at Rubens Capital Partners? Feel free to contact us.

04Portfolio

USA Residential

Core-plus and value-add multifamily in high-growth US markets, executed alongside trusted local operating partners.

Assets under management
$310m
Scale
1,300 units
Region
United States
  • High-growth Sun Belt and gateway metros
  • Core-plus and value-add business plans with local partners
  • Active since 2017 with a disciplined entry discipline

Through dedicated funds, Rubens Capital Partners invests in high-quality multifamily assets in carefully selected urban and suburban markets with strong demographic and economic fundamentals.

Rubens Capital Partners manages the full investment lifecycle in-house, including sourcing and acquisitions, due diligence, investment structuring, financing, asset management and exit execution. Local operating partners are carefully selected and closely managed, while strategic oversight and decision-making are centrally coordinated from the Netherlands.

Within the fund structure, Rubens Capital Partners acts as alternative investment fund manager (AIFM) in accordance with the AIFMD framework. This governance and compliance structure provides investors with a professionally managed, transparent and well-regulated investment proposition.
